questions.question: Are there any specialty items or handling needs that a moving service would need to accommodate?
questions.deterministic_rationale: This would clarify whether specialty-handling requirements must be considered when comparing moving-service models.

questions.question: Will you need temporary storage between leaving your current home and settling into the new one?
questions.deterministic_rationale: This would clarify whether temporary storage needs must be considered when comparing moving-service models.

questions.question: Would someone in your household be willing to drive a rental truck for the move?
questions.deterministic_rationale: This would clarify whether a service model that depends on household driving should remain under consideration.

questions.question: How much of the packing would you prefer the moving service to handle?
questions.deterministic_rationale: This would clarify which packing responsibilities matter when comparing moving-service models.

questions.question: For this move, how would you balance lower cost against having less work to do yourself?
questions.deterministic_rationale: This would clarify the cost-versus-convenience preference to apply when comparing moving-service models.
